title: Award-Winning Vocalist Marissa Mulder Headlining Girl Noticed Fundraiser
htmlContent:
[caption id="attachment_126375" align="aligncenter" width="200"] Photo Credit - vocalist Marissa Mulder[/caption] On Wednesday, January 31, 2018, at 7 pm, ArtServe will be hosting a "Fun-Raiser" for GIRL NOTICED. Providing the entertainment for the evening is award-winning vocalist MARISSA MULDER, returning to South Florida for this special benefit. She will be accompanied by Thomas Regis on piano. GIRL NOTICED is a Nationwide Mural Project, building & maintaining a world better informed about the positive impact the simple act of "Noticing" a girl has. Lori Pratico, who set up and runs GIRL NOTICED, explained that "Girl Noticed makes the bold statement that it is a community's responsibility to yield to the greatness in every girl and the goal of this program is to bring attention & awareness to the important role females play in our society." Each community helps select an individual to be recognized in a unique & compelling way. Nominations cover a wide spectrum, setting out from personal struggles to momentous achievements. The girl's image is traced in charcoal, along with the words "Notice Me," on a large exterior wall. Pratico added, "This benefit concert and auction will help raise funds for us to persist in going around the country and noticing girls and offering compelling workshops in their communities. It's a worthwhile task for people to contribute and be involved with." For more information, go to girlnoticed.com. MARISSA MULDER is a multi-award winning singer & a rising star forging a legacy of profound & inspiring live concert experiences. Moving to New York City in 2007, from Syracuse, NY, Marissa has become one of the most successful young cabaret artists on the Manhattan scene. In 2011, she beat out 60 other singers to win the MetroStar Challenge at the Metropolitan Room, an American Idol-type contest for up & coming cabaret artists. She has two CD's available for purchase Tom...In His Words & Illusions, both available on iTunes, CDbaby.com & Amazon. www.marissasings.com   ARTSERVE empowers local artists & cultural entities to achieve their vision, improve the cultural fabric of our community & discover innovations in the arts by providing ongoing programs, facilities & services that allow them to Exhibit, Promote, Educate, Instruct, Collaborate & Conduct Business. artserve.org DATE: Wednesday, Jan 31, 2018, 7 pm PLACE: ArtServe ~ 1350 East Sunrise Boulevard ~ Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304 ACTIVITIES: Silent Auction, Live Auction, Raffle, Refreshments & Appetizers Entertainment (Marissa Mulder) TICKETS: Gen. Adm: $25; VIP: $95 ~ includes 66:30 pm VIP Reception, champagne toast, premium seating, swag bag & more! RESERVATIONS: girlnoticed.brownpapertickets.com
